Name: Prochorus
Summary: Prochorus was one of the seven men chosen to serve tables in the Jerusalem church, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom. Tradition later links him with John, though Acts says nothing further of him.
KeyStory: Prochorus was chosen with six others to carry the daily distribution, freeing the apostles for prayer and the word.
LifeLesson: The church's first officers were chosen for character, not for show. Prochorus served tables and is remembered.
